description: Catalog of NASA Langley Turbulence Modeling Resource (TMR) verification and validation cases for turbulence models — flat plates, bumps-in-channel, airfoils (NACA 0012, NACA 4412), axisymmetric jets, a backward-facing step, the NASA wall-mounted hump, shock/boundary-layer interactions, a supersonic square duct, the ONERA M6 wing, and a high-Reynolds-number channel flow. Each entry gives the case id to pass to tmr_reference_data, its category (verification vs. validation), flow regime, and documented Mach/Reynolds conditions.

category.description: Filter to one category. Omit for all cases.
